home.topStatusLead: A central portal for project reporting, cross-team collaboration, documentation indexing and process traceability.

statusBar.title: Portal status
statusBar.iterationPending: Formal PM iteration data hidden in this submission build.

positioning.title: Project Positioning
positioning.lead: The home page explains what the project is, what the portal is for and where M2's visible boundary starts and ends.

systemMap.title: System Map Summary
systemMap.lead: The portal keeps the overall architecture readable through layers, interfaces and repository boundaries instead of turning the home page into a wall of equal cards.

progress.title: Progress Snapshot
progress.lead: The home page only exposes the current phase, next action and highlighted risk, then points to the full progress page.
progress.pendingNote: Formal schedule, milestones and blocker details are hidden in this submission build. The progress route remains ready for PM-maintained records.

latestUpdates.title: Latest Updates
latestUpdates.lead: Recent updates stay list-based so teachers and teammates can scan date, type, owner and summary quickly.

deliverables.title: Docs Hub Preview
deliverables.lead: The docs hub is presented as a document center, not a small-card gallery.

teams.title: Teams and Repositories
teams.lead: Related teams and repositories are shown together, but with clear separation between responsibility mapping and actual repo links.

m2.title: M2 Contribution
m2.lead: M2 remains visible as the portal maintainer without claiming ownership of the full product frontend.

overview.title: Progress Overview
overview.lead: The progress page focuses on time, stage and planning clarity rather than reusing the home-page overview.

progress.hiddenDataNote: Formal schedule data is hidden in this submission build. The route structure and content pipeline are ready for PM-maintained records.

gantt.title: Gantt and Task Table
gantt.lead: The portal uses a data-driven gantt panel instead of fake sprint cards, and the sample label remains visible until the confirmed PM schedule is imported.

hiddenSections.gantt: The gantt panel is wired and ready, but sample schedule data is hidden in the current submission build.
hiddenSections.milestones: Milestone cards will appear after PM-maintained records are published.
hiddenSections.sprints: Iteration digests are hidden here until confirmed progress records are available.
hiddenSections.risks: Risk register entries are hidden here until the team publishes confirmed items.

milestones.title: Milestones List
milestones.lead: Milestones keep owner, date, status and linked evidence visible without collapsing into a spreadsheet.

sprints.title: Iteration Digests
sprints.lead: Iteration summaries show goal, completed work, incomplete work, blockers and next steps.

risks.title: Risk Register
risks.lead: Active risks remain visible with mitigation notes, ownership and update dates.

logs.title: Logs and Process Records
logs.lead: The logs hub keeps updates, meetings, weekly reports, research notes and decisions searchable and shareable.

docs.title: Documents and Deliverables
docs.lead: Formal documents stay grouped by category, review state and archive state, but the reading rhythm is row-based rather than card-grid based.

current.title: Current Documents
current.lead: {{count}} current documents match the active category filter.

archived.title: Archived Documents
archived.lead: {{count}} archived entries remain available for traceability.

overview.title: Overall System Overview
overview.lead: Architecture is explained through layers, responsibilities and handoff logic rather than a complex interactive visual tool.

teamMatrix.title: Team Responsibility Matrix
teamMatrix.lead: Each team block states responsibility, inputs, outputs and how that team connects to M2.

repositories.title: Repository Map
repositories.lead: The repository map keeps role, maintainer, status and scope boundary visible.

interfaces.title: Interface Dependencies
interfaces.lead: IF1 and IF2 are described in plain language with emphasis on what M2 consumes and what remains upstream.

roles.title: Role Matrix
roles.lead: Portal work is also mapped to PM, coordination, architecture, implementation and testing responsibilities.

calendar.title: Project Calendar
calendar.lead: A restrained month calendar for milestones, meetings, deadlines, demos and public holidays across China and Portugal.

monthView.title: Month View
monthView.lead: The calendar keeps only the necessary controls: month paging, type filters and a selected-day detail area.

calendar.noEvents: No events for the selected day.
calendar.emptySelection: Select a day or event to inspect details.
calendar.sampleEventNote: Project-specific calendar events are currently marked as SAMPLE until the PM-maintained schedule is confirmed.
calendar.staticHolidayNote: China and Portugal holidays are generated into static JSON so the portal remains usable without runtime requests.

team.title: Team Members
team.lead: This page introduces the M2 members maintaining the portal, their working focus and the cross-timezone collaboration context.
team.membersLead: Each card focuses on responsibility, timezone and contribution focus rather than a social-style profile wall.
team.rolesLead: This complements the architecture page by restating role responsibilities from a team-maintenance point of view.
team.timezonesLead: China and Portugal time are kept visible because coordination decisions in the portal often depend on them.

examples.title: Examples and Templates
examples.lead: Examples stay visible in one place so teammates can learn the expected writing structure without mixing templates into factual records.
examples.policyBody: Any non-factual content must stay clearly marked as SAMPLE, EXAMPLE, MOCK or TEMPLATE. These entries exist to teach structure, not to impersonate real project history.
examples.authoringBody: Logs, docs, weekly reports, meeting notes and research notes should be updated through markdown first. Keep slugs stable and link evidence whenever the claim matters.
examples.docsLead: {{count}} example document entries are currently indexed.
examples.logsLead: {{count}} example log-style entries are currently indexed.

notFound.lead: The requested page or content record is not available.

footer.description: A document-first project hub maintained by M2 for reporting, collaboration indexing and traceable delivery review.
